status: PRE-REGISTERED DESIGN ONLY. No return backtest has been run for any hypothesis below. Execution is a later milestone.
scope: Observable signal -> future risk-adjusted returns; long-only, monthly, liquid, executable by Indonesian retail investors (100-share lots, IDX auto-rejection limits, no shorting).

not_registered_and_why.residual_momentum_palm: already explored on the same palm universe (Phase II quant: mean rank IC +0.04, t 0.93, 100 months); re-testing would be hindsight
not_registered_and_why.valuation_dispersion: no point-in-time fundamentals (Yahoo statements are restated and short)
not_registered_and_why.earnings_revisions: no consensus history before 2026-11-24 (forward logging only)
not_registered_and_why.cross_sectional_palm_momentum: only ~9 names trade > IDR 5bn/day; cross-section too narrow

common_rules.signal_timing: signals use only data published by the last trading day of month t; positions held for month t+1 (no same-day look-ahead)
common_rules.commodity_publication_lag: World Bank CMO month t-1 average is the latest commodity input at the end of month t (published ~2nd business day of month t)
common_rules.off_asset: money-market proxy at the BI-Rate minus 0.5pp per year (EST); for long-only retail feasibility
common_rules.costs: 0.45% per full switch (0.20% buy + 0.25% sell incl. 0.10% sales tax) for large caps; 1.0% for names with median ADV < IDR 10bn; basket rebalancing at 0.3% of traded value
common_rules.inference: monthly net return difference vs benchmark; Newey-West HAC t (lag 3); moving-block bootstrap CI; Holm across the 3 registered hypotheses (and reported programme-wide)
common_rules.pass_rule: annualised net excess return vs the primary benchmark >= 3% AND Holm-adjusted HAC p <= 0.05 AND positive in both halves of the sample AND max drawdown not worse than the primary benchmark
common_rules.after_pass: 12 months of prospective paper tracking (journaled monthly) before any use; no BUY recommendation from a backtest
common_rules.factor_adjustment: report alpha vs IHSG and vs the sector basket (OLS, HAC); a pass that is only sector/commodity beta is NOT alpha

R1_palm_cpo_impulse_timing.mechanism: palm equities under-react to CPO price changes because earnings recognise prices with a lag (levy/reference-price mechanics, inventory, contract lags; cf. ITMG-C1 partial pass-through)
R1_palm_cpo_impulse_timing.signal: dlog of CMO palm oil price in IDR (USD price x month-average USD/IDR) for month t-1 vs t-2
R1_palm_cpo_impulse_timing.rule: if signal > 0 hold the equal-weight basket of palm names in the PIT core_liquidity band (pit_universe_monthly.csv) for month t+1, else the off-asset
R1_palm_cpo_impulse_timing.primary_benchmark: buy-and-hold of the same PIT palm basket (monthly rebalanced)
R1_palm_cpo_impulse_timing.data_status: available in repo (benchmarks_daily, pit_universe_monthly, macro_monthly); survivorship: delisted GOLL/MAGP lack prices (suspended for most of the sample)

R2_coal_newcastle_impulse_timing.mechanism: same under-reaction channel for coal producers (Newcastle -> ASP pass-through ~0.74 with lag, ITMG-C1)
R2_coal_newcastle_impulse_timing.signal: dlog CMO Newcastle (USD) month t-1 vs t-2
R2_coal_newcastle_impulse_timing.rule: if signal > 0 hold the equal-weight basket of coal producers with trailing 6-month median ADV >= IDR 10bn at month t, else the off-asset
R2_coal_newcastle_impulse_timing.primary_benchmark: buy-and-hold of the same liquid coal basket
R2_coal_newcastle_impulse_timing.data_status: REQUIRES acquisition of coal OHLCV (existing quant/fetch_ohlcv.py) and a corporate-action check (e.g. ADRO/AADI 2024 restructuring); survivors-only bias to be documented

R3_liquid_idx_12_1_momentum.mechanism: intermediate-horizon momentum (under-reaction / slow information diffusion) in a liquid emerging-market universe
R3_liquid_idx_12_1_momentum.universe: IDX stocks with >= 12 months of history, price >= IDR 200, top 100 by trailing 6-month median ADV at month t (PIT from price data)
R3_liquid_idx_12_1_momentum.signal: total return months t-12..t-1 (skip month t)
R3_liquid_idx_12_1_momentum.rule: hold the top 20 names equal-weighted for month t+1; monthly rebalance
R3_liquid_idx_12_1_momentum.primary_benchmark: equal-weight of the same liquid universe
R3_liquid_idx_12_1_momentum.data_status: REQUIRES acquisition of ~300 tickers' OHLCV; Yahoo lacks delisted stocks -> survivorship bias must be quantified (IDX delisting list) before execution; lowest priority

change_policy: no changes after any backtest is run; new ideas need new registration
